tz-taste.description: Verde starter: a SvelteKit landing page for a fictional houseplant-care app, styled as a botanist's field journal. Features are specimen plates with Latin captions, hairline frames and plate numbers (No. 01–No. 04). DNA tokens live in src/app.css as CSS vars; fonts (DM Serif Display / Karla / Space Mono) load in src/app.html.
